feedstock_sc_assessments_validity_window.name: feedstock_sc_assessments_validity_window
feedstock_sc_assessments_validity_window.value: "feedstock_sc_assessments"."valid_from" is null or "feedstock_sc_assessments"."valid_to" is null or "feedstock_sc_assessments"."valid_from" <= "feedstock_sc_assessments"."valid_to"

credit_batches_1000_year_requires_reflec.name: credit_batches_1000_year_requires_reflectance_and_non_reactive_carbon
credit_batches_1000_year_requires_reflec.value:
"credit_batches"."durability_option" <> '1000_year'::durability_option or (
        "credit_batches"."mean_random_reflectance_percent" is not null and
        "credit_batches"."mean_non_reactive_carbon_percent" is not null
      )

production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet.name: production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet
production_runs_feedstock_dry_lte_wet.value: "production_runs"."feedstock_wet_mass_kg" is null or "production_runs"."feedstock_mass_dry_kg" is null or "production_runs"."feedstock_mass_dry_kg" <= "production_runs"."feedstock_wet_mass_kg"

deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass.name: deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass
deliveries_mass_dry_lte_wet_mass.value: "deliveries"."mass_dry_kg" is null or "deliveries"."delivered_wet_mass_kg" is null or "deliveries"."mass_dry_kg" <= "deliveries"."delivered_wet_mass_kg"

deliveries_truck_mass_arrival_gte_depart.name: deliveries_truck_mass_arrival_gte_departure
deliveries_truck_mass_arrival_gte_depart.value: "deliveries"."truck_mass_on_arrival_kg" is null or "deliveries"."truck_mass_on_departure_kg" is null or "deliveries"."truck_mass_on_arrival_kg" >= "deliveries"."truck_mass_on_departure_kg"

transport_legs_energy_usage_requirements.name: transport_legs_energy_usage_requirements
transport_legs_energy_usage_requirements.value:
"transport_legs"."calculation_method" <> 'energy_usage'::emissions_calculation_method or (
        "transport_legs"."fuel_type" is not null and
        ("transport_legs"."fuel_consumed_liters" is not null or "transport_legs"."electricity_kwh" is not null) and
        "transport_legs"."emission_factor_used" is not null
      )

transport_legs_distance_based_requiremen.name: transport_legs_distance_based_requirements
transport_legs_distance_based_requiremen.value:
"transport_legs"."calculation_method" <> 'distance_based'::emissions_calculation_method or (
        "transport_legs"."load_mass_kg" is not null and
        "transport_legs"."vehicle_type" is not null and
        "transport_legs"."emission_factor_used" is not null
      )
